comparisons.peer_topic: Shareholder Returns and Stock Repurchase Program
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD returned $862 million to shareholders in 2024 through stock repurchases, with $4.7 billion remaining available under a program that has no termination date and may be suspended or discontinued at any time.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose their fiscal year 2024 stock repurchase activity and remaining authorization. AMD repurchased $862 million worth of shares and has $4.7 billion remaining under a program with no termination date, whereas Broadcom utilized all $20 billion of its authorized amounts prior to expiration, having repurchased $7,176 million in fiscal 2024.

sentences.text: During fiscal years 2024 and 2023, we repurchased and retired approximately 67 million and 91 million shares of our common stock for $7,176 million and $5,824 million, respectively.
All $20 billion of the authorized amount under these stock repurchase programs was utilized prior to expiration on December 31, 2023.
During the twelve months ended December 28, 2024, we returned a total of $862 million to shareholders through the repurchase of 5.9 million shares of common stock under our stock repurchase program.
As of December 28, 2024, $4.7 billion remained available for future stock repurchases under this program.

sentences.text: In May 2022, our Board of Directors authorized another stock repurchase program to repurchase up to an additional $10 billion of our common stock from time to time through December 31, 2023.
All $20 billion of the authorized amount under these stock repurchase programs was utilized prior to expiration on December 31, 2023.

Our Board of Directors has authorized the discretionary repurchase of up to $10 billion of our outstanding common stock through open-market purchases, block trades, privately-negotiated transactions, derivative transactions, and/or pursuant to Rule 10b5-1 trading plans.

The repurchase authorization has no expiration date, does not obligate us to acquire any common stock, and is subject to market conditions and our ongoing determination of the best use of available cash.
Through August 29, 2024, we had repurchased an aggregate of $7.19 billion of the authorized amount.
